primary.desc: Tap to throw the hammer: it flies to the cursor (up to 9m), passes through foes, stays planted under a gold beacon (your team sees foes near it) and comes back when you tap again, hitting on the way; its rope hauls it home on its own past 14m or after 6s, and it can't be thrown again till it's back. Hold to spin it up into a Crushing Blow (full at 1.25s: 66 damage, a big knock, stun 0.4): a flaming crescent in front that lunges you 1.4-2.4m forward on top of your run (about half that in the air). Right click raises the aegis; with it up, left click thrusts it forward and shoves foes 2.8m.
